title: capsella perconcava
intro: Capsella perconcava, commonly known as shepherd's purse, is a biennial flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including bleeding and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as promoting wound healing and reducing menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of shepherd's purse include its ability to act as an astringent, anti-inflammatory, and emmenagogue, making it useful for treating conditions such as diarrhea and heavy menstrual bleeding. The bioactive constituents of shepherd's purse include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
